title: P5-08: Google sign-in on the new CMS, first admin and editors
description:
## Goal
Google sign-in works on the new CMS at `/newsroom`; Ryan is the first admin; editors are added. The shared OAuth client gets the new Cognito URIs.

## Context (FACT)
- One shared Google OAuth client (project 94722830066, client id begins 94722830066-7pf0ui44...). Ryan removed the earlier Papyrus sites' Cognito URIs on 2026-10-05 to stay under the 10 unverified-domain limit, so Google sign-in on the OLD p.apyr.us is expected broken today.
- Old pool us-east-1_40Uot7WSv: 4 users (1 CONFIRMED, 3 EXTERNAL_PROVIDER), groups admin 2, editor 4, curator 0; rows UserIdentity 3, UserProfile 2, UserRoleAssignment 3, keyed by Cognito subject, so they cannot be copied to a new pool; these 3 people re-sign in and are re-assigned (Q6).
- docs/google-oauth-setup.md: Google needs only the Cognito origin `https://papyrus-p-apyr-us.auth.us-east-1.amazoncognito.com` and `/oauth2/idpresponse`; app return URLs come from `backend.auth.redirectUrls` in papyrus.config.ts (P5-05), which feeds Cognito callbacks.
- Secrets live in SSM at `/amplify/<appId>/main-branch-<hash>/` where hash = first 10 hex chars of sha512(appId + "main"); names GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID, GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET (OPENAI_API_KEY only if the console responder is kept). Names only, never values, in tickets and logs.
- The marketing root `/` does not handle OAuth codes; the sign-in return path is `/newsroom`.

## Exact steps
1. Compute the hash and the SSM path from the new AppId (P5-07) and record the path.
2. Ryan: add the two URIs to the Google client (check the 10-domain limit first); set the two secrets in the Amplify console (or `aws ssm put-parameter` run by Ryan).
3. Trigger a backend build; confirm the Cognito domain and Google IdP exist (`describe-user-pool-domain`, `list-identity-providers`).
4. Ryan signs in at `https://main.<appId>.amplifyapp.com/newsroom`; add him to group `admin` (manage-user-role Lambda or Cognito console); sign in the editors.

## Acceptance checks
- `/newsroom` shows Continue with Google, completes sign-in, lands on `/newsroom` (not `/`), shows the admin UI.
- `aws cognito-idp admin-list-groups-for-user` shows `admin` for Ryan; a non-admin account gets the editor-only view.
- The login works from `http://localhost:3001/newsroom` and from the staging host after P5-10.

## Rollback
Remove the added URIs; old pool untouched.

## Risks
10 unverified-domain limit; wrong redirectUrls give "redirect_mismatch" or "oauth param not configured" (symptom list in docs/site-hosting.md).

## Needs Ryan
Yes: Google console URIs, secrets, first sign-in, group assignment.
right_now_summary: Ryan needs to add Google OAuth URIs and secrets, then sign in and assign editor access.
